# Municipal Ordinance No. 03, Series of 2014

**An Ordinance Implementing Forced Evacuation as a Resort When a Disaster or Emergency Has Been Declared in the Municipality of Pitogo, Quezon and Danger of Loss of Lives Becomes Imminent, Providing Penalties Therefor and for Other Purposes**

Resolution No. 175

## Summary

Implements forced evacuation measures for the [[Municipality of Pitogo]] when a disaster or emergency has been declared and danger of loss of lives becomes imminent. References RA 10121 (Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010), Section 2(a), on disaster risk reduction. LGUs are authorized under [[Sec-16-RA7160]] (General Welfare) and [[Sec-444-RA7160]]/[[Sec-447-RA7160]] to carry out emergency measures. Provides penalties for non-compliance.

## Key Provisions

- **Forced Evacuation Authority:** The municipal government may order forced evacuation when a disaster or emergency has been officially declared
- **Trigger Conditions:** Applicable when danger of loss of lives becomes imminent
- **Penalties:** Provides penalties for persons who refuse to comply with forced evacuation orders
- **DRRM Integration:** Aligned with RA 10121 (PDRRM Act of 2010) framework
